evals.prompt: Write tasks for checkout-foundation (CHK01) from specs/checkout-foundation/design.md.
evals.expected_output: specs/checkout-foundation/TASKS.local.md with stories, each with a statement, independent test criterion and Gherkin AC, and tasks beneath them.
assertions: Creates or updates specs/checkout-foundation/TASKS.local.md
Every story has an As a/I want/So that statement
Every story has an independent test criterion
Every story has >=1 Gherkin scenario with observable Then clauses
Task IDs use CHK01- prefix and carry [S{n}] labels
Story 1 is identified as the MVP
Does not write docs/product/backlog.md for an existing epic

evals.expected_output: An epic row added to backlog.md and a matching TASKS.local.md written, both paths reported.
assertions: Reads the spec at the given path
Derives a kebab-case slug of at most two words
Reads backlog.md before assigning an Epic ID so it does not collide
Writes both docs/product/backlog.md and specs/{work-short-name}/TASKS.local.md
Reports both paths in the summary

evals.prompt: Write the epics for this product from product.md and roadmap.md.
evals.expected_output: docs/product/backlog.md with an epic table, Now-phase detail, dependency graph and risks.
assertions: Writes docs/product/backlog.md only
Every Now-phase epic traces to a product.md outcome
No full Gherkin in backlog.md
Work path slugs are at most two words and not Epic IDs

evals.prompt: Write tasks for auth-tokens with EARS.
evals.expected_output: TASKS.local.md where every story carries Gherkin plus EARS statements using the five patterns.
assertions: Every story has both Gherkin and EARS sections
EARS statements use THE SYSTEM SHALL
EARS statements do not restate a Gherkin scenario

evals.expected_output: Resolves the source system and type before writing anything; if Jira and Linear are both plausible or neither MCP tool is reachable, asks the user rather than guessing. Once resolved as a Jira story, writes sub-tasks inheriting the story's Gherkin AC to the story's own TASKS.local.md (or as tracker sub-issues), using the Jira key as the canonical ID with no parallel internal ID invented.
assertions: Reads work-items.md before acting
Does not guess between Jira and Linear when ambiguous — asks the user
Uses JIRA-123 as the canonical ID; does not invent an internal ID alongside it
Sub-tasks inherit the parent story's Gherkin scenario(s)
Writes to specs/{work-short-name}/TASKS.local.md (or specs/JIRA-123/ when no short name is known, or creates tracker sub-issues), not the parent epic's TASKS.local.md
If this is a fresh Jira/Linear resolution (not one already trusted from an existing TASKS.local.md), writes a TASKS.local.md pointer at the repo root

evals.expected_output: CHK01-04 resolves to type task, a leaf item — confirms intent with the user rather than silently decomposing or refusing outright.
assertions: Resolves the argument's type before acting
Does not silently decompose a task-type work item
Asks the user whether decomposition is genuinely intended, or suggests implement instead
